turns: How many bluefin can I keep per day?
case.expect: 2 per day (CA + federal), last-checked date, check the official page with a CDFW/NOAA link.

turns.user: How many bluefin can I keep per day?
turns.text:
California's limit is **2 bluefin tuna per angler per day**, and that's in addition to the 20-fish general finfish limit. The federal rule (50 CFR §660.721) is also 2.

On multi-day trips, you can keep up to 3 daily limits total — but only if the boat filed a CDFW Multi-Day Fishing Trip declaration, and still only one daily limit per calendar day.

If you're fishing Mexican waters, the rules are different: Mexico's overall limit is 10 fish per angler with no more than 5 of one species, so effectively up to 5 bluefin there. Confirm with your landing which waters your trip fishes.

This is a summary last checked 11/25/2026 — rules change, so verify before you go: [CDFW bag & size limits](https://wildlife.ca.gov/Regions/Marine/FAQ/general-commercial-and-recreational-recreational-what-are-the-sport-regulations-for-the-fish-species-i-am-taking) and [NOAA 50 CFR §660.721](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/chapter-VI/part-660/subpart-K/section-660.721).
